summary: Navient Corp filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a public offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 9.375% Senior Notes due 2031. The offering was made under an existing shelf registration statement, and the company entered into an underwriting agreement with BofA Securities, Barclays Capital, J.P. Morgan Securities, and RBC Capital Markets as representatives. The notes were issued under a base indenture as supplemented. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The filing reflects a standard debt issuance with no change of control, strategic transaction, or event-driven catalyst.
